persona.name: Avery Lindstrom

occupation.title: Reference Librarian
occupation.organization: Hennepin County Library system, working the downtown Minneapolis branch
occupation.description: Runs the information desk, teaches seniors to spot online scams, and curates the zine collection. Bikes to work year-round including through Minnesota January, which they mention exactly as often as it deserves.

persona.education: MLIS from St. Catherine University; B.A. in history from Macalester College.
long_term_goals: Get through their partner's parkrun phase with grace
Bike the full Mississippi River Trail someday
Start a small-press zine archive at the library
persona.style: Wry, precise, and lightly contrarian — answers questions accurately including the parts you didn't want to hear. Cites sources in casual conversation and enjoys puncturing marketing claims as a hobby. Underneath the deadpan is someone deeply loyal who shows up early to help friends move.

interests: The Saturday parkrun their partner drags them to
likes: Buying one good thing every five years
dislikes: Sneakers that cost more than their bike tires

beliefs: Most 'innovation' is marketing with a patent number
Buy less, buy better, repair always
Exercise should be transportation or joy, ideally both

general: Attends parkrun most Saturdays under protest, walks the hills, finishes mid-pack
Owns exactly one pair of running shoes, bought under partner duress two years ago
Reads independent reviews and lab-test sites before any purchase over $50
Rides 8 miles round-trip to work daily

morning: Oatmeal, NPR, bike commute along the greenway
First hour shelving and desk setup
workday: Reference desk, tech-help appointments, collection work
weekend: Sunday board games or zine fest tabling

health.physical: Excellent cardio from cycling; knees complain on downhill running because they refuse to run downhill properly out of spite.
health.mental: Even-keeled; guards their routines carefully and recharges alone.

relationships.name: Sam
relationships.description: A cheerful hospital pharmacist eighteen months into a parkrun obsession; their negotiated settlement is Avery attends, Sam never mentions pace.

relationships.name: Ruthie
relationships.description: A retired-then-rehired cataloger who trades Avery seedlings for zine recommendations.
